description: Equilibrium Climate Sensitivity (K) per CMIP6 model, for the two-axis cross-check (conservation x sensitivity).
source: Zelinka et al. 2020, Geophys. Res. Lett. 47, e2019GL085782, doi:10.1029/2019GL085782. Data: github.com/mzelinka/cmip56_forcing_feedback_ecs (v2.2, 2022-06-15).
range_source: IPCC AR6 likely range 2.5-4.0 C; >4.5 C is the 'hot model' problem (Hausfather et al. 2022, Nature).
